description: This source file defines the onboarding wizard model and associated views for a SwiftUI-based onboarding flow. It manages the wizard's state, handles server requests to start, submit, and cancel wizard steps, and provides user interface components for rendering each step with different control types.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A final class conforming to Observable, managing the onboarding wizard's state, lifecycle, and server interactions on the main thread.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardStepView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct rendering individual wizard steps with appropriate input controls and submitting user responses.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the wizard's internal state to initial/default values.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the wizard flow if conditions are met, performing server communication asynchronously.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a user's answer for the current wizard step asynchronously.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing wizard session if it's active.

methods.name: applyStartResult
methods.description: Processes the server response upon starting the wizard and updates internal state.

methods.name: applyNextResult
methods.description: Processes the server response upon progressing to the next wizard step.

methods.name: applyStatusResult
methods.description: Processes the server response for wizard status updates.

methods.name: restartIfSessionLost
methods.description: Handles session loss errors by attempting to restart the wizard if conditions permit.

methods.name: shouldSkipWizard
methods.description: Determines whether to skip the wizard process based on configuration or authentication state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI visual layout for the wizard step, dynamically adjusting input controls based on step type.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles user action to submit current input responses, calling a closure with appropriate answer data.
